title: Machine config and connections
summary: The protected connection marker means real data. CLI flags are --protected and --unprotected; legacy stored prod keys normalize on config writes. Config parents must belong to the current user and deny other users write access; inherited Windows ACLs and read-only grants are allowed. Machine homes, secrets and locks require owner-private access. On Windows, an explicit or inherited allow entry for another principal fails that check, including read-only entries.
